title: Convex cached AABB shape construction
summary: Recovered VA 0x47b640: thiscall initialization of the 32-bit btConvexInternalAabbCachingShape base, returning this. Stores shape type 35, null user pointer, unit scaling, margin 0.04f, original vtable identity, inverted AABB and false cache validity; preserves all unassigned fields and padding. Original caller at 0x4d0af5 subsequently installs a derived vtable.
test_description: Direct original thiscall comparison on 32 initial byte patterns under 16 MXCSR configurations; compares full object and surrounding guards, checks return pointer, untouched dimensions/unknown field/padding, repeated initialization and unchanged MXCSR.
known_limits: Original vtable address is retained as a 32-bit identity token; virtual dispatch and a Linux replacement vtable are outside this bounded routine.
Field names follow the Bullet shape layout; the untouched +0x30 field remains unresolved.
Requires valid writable object storage; null or inaccessible this is outside the original contract.
No matching-byte claim or recovery of derived constructors and physics behavior.
